integrity: Proof from explicit integer Vandermonde optimization and a Pell descent; included finite checker corroborates the theorem but is not a substitute for its proof.
scientific_limitations: The exact formula is for the canonical integer moment-curve embedding. All vertex-supported maximizers are characterized; nonvertex equality configurations are not. Historical priority requires additional literature checking, and independent mathematical validation is not performed.
title: Fibonacci resonances in maximal tetrahedra of integer-spaced cyclic three-polytopes
